en.name: Blazing Revival
entries: {@i 14th-level Circle of Wildfire feature}

The bond with your wildfire spirit can save you from death. If the spirit is within 120 feet of you when you are reduced to 0 hit points and thereby fall {@condition unconscious}, you can cause the spirit to drop to 0 hit points. You then regain half your hit points and immediately rise to your feet.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Vous récupérez alors la moitié de vos points de vie et vous relevez immédiatement.

en.name: Blessed Strikes
entries: {@i 8th-level cleric {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}, which replaces the Potent Spellcasting feature}

You are blessed with divine might in battle. When a creature takes damage from one of your cantrips or weapon attacks, you can also deal {@damage 1d8} radiant damage to that creature. Once you deal this damage, you can't use this feature again until the start of your next turn.

en.name: Body of the Astral Self
entries: {@i 11th-level Way of the Astral Self feature}

When you have both your astral arms and visage summoned, you can cause the body of your astral self to appear (no action required). This spectral body covers your physical form like a suit of armor, connecting with the arms and visage. You determine its appearance.
While the spectral body is present, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deflect Energy
entries: When you take acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to deflect it. When you do so, the damage you take is reduced by {@dice 1d10} + your Wisdom modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

entries.name: Empowered Arms
entries: Once on each of your turns when you hit a target with the Arms of the Astral Self, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to your Martial Arts die.

texts.fr: Corps du Moi astral

en.name: Bolstering Magic
entries: {@i 6th-level Path of Wild Magic feature}

You can harness your wild magic to bolster yourself or a companion. As an action, you can touch one creature (which can be yourself) and confer one of the following benefits of your choice to that creature:

items: For 10 minutes, the creature can roll a {@dice d3} whenever making an attack roll or an ability check and add the number rolled to the {@dice d20} roll.

Roll a {@dice d3}. The creature regains one expended spell slot, the level of which equals the number rolled or lower (the creature's choice). Once a creature receives this benefit, that creature can't receive it again until after a long rest.

en.name: Bottled Respite
entries: As an action, you can magically vanish and enter your vessel, which remains in the space you left. The interior of the vessel is an extradimensional space in the shape of a 20-foot-radius cylinder, 20 feet high, and resembles your vessel. The interior is appointed with cushions and low tables and is a comfortable temperature. While inside, you can hear the area around your vessel as if you were in its space. You can remain inside the vessel up to a number of hours equal to twice your proficiency bonus. You exit the vessel early if you use a bonus action to leave, if you die, or if the vessel is destroyed. When you exit the vessel, you appear in the unoccupied space closest to it. Any objects left in the vessel remain there until carried out, and if the vessel is destroyed, every object stored there harmlessly appears in the unoccupied spaces closest to the vessel's former space. Once you enter the vessel, you can't enter again until you finish a long rest.

texts.fr: Répit en bouteille

review.reason: Comparaison intégrale EN/FR : sens, conditions, nombres, coûts, durées, ciblage et balises conservés.

texts.fr: Par une action, vous pouvez disparaître magiquement et entrer dans votre réceptacle, qui reste dans l'espace que vous avez quitté. Son intérieur est un espace extradimensionnel en forme de cylindre de 20 pieds de rayon et de 20 pieds de haut, qui ressemble à votre réceptacle. Il est garni de coussins et de tables basses et sa température est agréable. À l'intérieur, vous entendez les alentours du réceptacle comme si vous étiez dans son espace. Vous pouvez y rester un nombre d'heures au plus égal au double de votre bonus de maîtrise. Vous en sortez prématurément si vous utilisez une action bonus pour partir, si vous mourez ou si le réceptacle est détruit. Lorsque vous en sortez, vous apparaissez dans l'espace inoccupé le plus proche. Les objets laissés dans le réceptacle y restent jusqu'à ce qu'on les emporte ; s'il est détruit, tous les objets qui y étaient rangés apparaissent sans dommage dans les espaces inoccupés les plus proches de son ancien emplacement. Une fois entré dans le réceptacle, vous ne pouvez plus y entrer avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.
